item.text:
No additional defect was confirmed in this pass. The remaining code paths are covered by existing findings or require assumptions outside the authorized crash-fault model.

The audit remains at 28 confirmed findings. Highest-impact issues are:

- LFU cache resynchronization causing different replica values at the same decided index,
- delta-snapshot synchronization corruption,
- `AcceptSync` decided-index regression,
- persistent failed-write leakage and destructive suffix replacement,
- timeout retry duplication,
- LRU bincode deserialization failure.

The full report and retained reproduction artifacts remain at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
